verdict: Client failed to download policy from its management point. Without policy the client cannot evaluate deployments, compliance, or updates.
fix: From the client, trigger a machine policy retrieval: `Invoke-CimMethod -Namespace root\ccm -ClassName SMS_Client -MethodName TriggerSchedule -Arguments @{ sScheduleID = '{00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000021}' }`. If policy still fails, confirm `http://<mp-fqdn>/ccm_system/request` responds. On the MP, verify IIS bindings and that the `CCM_Incoming` app pool is running.
